messages:
maya: Quick design q — trying to reconcile 'burst' behaviour in the Dedicated Capacity panel. Attached mock shows a 'smoothing' slider and a new 'favorites' star on GPU pools. Thoughts?

dan: Can you paste the mock image or Figma link? Also, what's the exact difference you want between 'smoothing' and the existing 'burst' concept? Users get confused.

maya: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz — snippet copy I'm trying: 

```
Burst smoothing: limit peak throughput changes per minute to reduce cold-start and billing spikes.
```

Thinking label options: 'Burst smoothing' vs 'Ramp rate'.

ali: I prefer 'Ramp rate' — infra folks will understand it. 'Smoothing' feels fuzzy.

emily: From product side, users asked for simple guidance. Maybe two short lines: 'Burst = short spikes. Ramp rate = controlled growth.' Tooltip examples would help.

maya: UX idea: add a small star chip next to each pool in the picker to mark a 'favorite' pool. Favorited pools float to top and show last 1h latency / cost-per-token inline. Accessibility: star should be keyboard focusable and have aria-pressed states.

dan: +1 on favorites. Accessibility nit: ensure hit target >= 44px and color contrast for the star toggle — yellow on white is low contrast.

ali: Copy tweak for the SLO slider: change label from 'Target latency' to 'SLO latency (p99)' and show units (ms). That reduces hand-waving.

emily: Also propose guardrail presets under the slider: 'Aggressive', 'Balanced', 'Conservative' — each with a single-line hint (e.g., 'Aggressive: lower latency, higher cost'). That helps new users pick quickly.

maya: Mock updated: added presets and a one-line 'why this matters' microcopy under the slider. Added a tiny 'what-if' link that opens docs in a panel.

dan: The microcopy is a bit long when translated. Suggest one short sentence + 'Learn more' link.

ali: Accessibility nit: preset chips should be real radio buttons for screen readers, not just div toggles. Also ensure focus order makes sense with keyboard nav.

maya: Noted. I'll convert to radios and update focus states in Figma.

maya: Two open questions for the group before I update mocks: 1) What unit should we show for 'burst throughput' in Dedicated? GPU cores / vCPU / GPU-minutes? 2) Final preference: 'Ramp rate' or 'Burst smoothing' as the label?

emily: Ops prefers 'burst throughput (GPU cores)' for Dedicated to match billing. And infra likes 'Ramp rate' as the label. So my recommendation: label the control 'Ramp rate' with small subcopy 'limits how quickly capacity can increase (GPU cores / min)'.

deploy-bot: New Figma link posted by maya: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz — frame 'dedicated/pool-picker-ramp'

maya: Thanks — I'll update the PR for the copy and accessibility changes. I'll also add a short help text for the favorites feature and a11y notes. Back with an iteration tomorrow. :thumbsup:
